EVAL-F-001-S1.title: Define Clinical Trials Search Schema and Contract
EVAL-F-001-S1.description: Define request/response schema for clinical trials search including condition, location, recruiting status, structured trial fields (id, title, phase, status, locations), eligibility summary, and optional travel metrics.

EVAL-F-001-S2.title: Implement ClinicalTrials.gov Search Logic
EVAL-F-001-S2.description: Implement backend service to query ClinicalTrials.gov with recruiting filter, map API response into structured schema, and extract trial locations and eligibility summaries.

EVAL-F-001-S3.title: Add Travel Distance and Time Enrichment
EVAL-F-001-S3.description: Integrate Google Routes to compute travel distance and duration from user location to trial sites and append enrichment to each trial location.

EVAL-F-001-S4.title: Expose Clinical Trials Search via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-F-001-S4.description: Expose clinical trials search through evaluate_care_facade and tool router, ensuring validated inputs and structured outputs are returned to the chat layer.

EVAL-F-001-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Clinical Trials Search
EVAL-F-001-S5.description: Create unit tests for schema validation and service logic, plus integration tests covering facade invocation, tool routing, and optional travel enrichment paths.
EVAL-F-001-S5.evidence: GAP: No existing test file for clinical trials; must be created under backend/tests/
